name: Collection O Southern Star Hotel
detail: Очень хороший для своей цены отель! Путешествовал с другом, у нас было два номера одного типа. Все работало, санузел превосходный, были холодильники, два типа вентиляции: кондей и большой вентилятор на потолке. Большое количество вешалок в гардеробе при входе. ТВ. С вайфаем никаких проблем - это, похоже, вообще фича Вьетнама! У нас в номерах не было окон, но это особенность, а не недостаток. Персонал - обычный. Написано, что знает английский - не знает. За это 4 балла. Важно - несмотря на то, что на карте это место выглядит как центр - это переферия! Да нормального центра - 25 минут на мототакси или обычном такси. Поэтому - 3 за локацию. Но Grab работает превосходно: вызвать и доехать никаких проблем. Были проездом, поэтому возможно, я упустил какие-то плюсы. Просто совет: такси только! по приложению! Никаких свободных грабберов на улицах, которые подъезжают и предлагают так же или дешевле.
area: District 12,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: Palette Amura Hotel - Near Gigamall
detail: I visited twice; the first time was great. The second time I went back, there was a staff member in the afternoon shift, and I wasn't very happy with their attitude. During my second stay, the water heater in the room didn't work in the evening; I waited quite a while for hot water but didn’t get any. If possible, I recommend everyone book the deluxe room, I find it better, and the prices on the app are better than booking directly outside. Don't be like me, asking questions and then booking through the app, which made the staff’s attitude change. The staff member working the night shift was very good and enthusiastic.
area: Thủ Đức,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: Collection O District 10 - Bonita Grand Hotel
detail: The hotel is located in the center, convenient, with many eateries. The promotional price is low but you get to stay in a large room. However, the room wasn't very clean in the surrounding areas due to a lot of dust and stains. Furthermore, I prefer the bathroom to have slightly brighter lighting because it feels a bit dim when you enter the room.
area: District 10,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: LOTTE HOTEL SAIGON
detail: The room, especially the bathroom, showed signs of age, but it was clean, the bed was comfortable, and it was nice that there was a small convenience store just to the right of the entrance. The breakfast was average, but the staff was friendly and approached us first, which was nice. It seems that the spa gets booked quickly on weekends, so make a reservation in advance. (I was disappointed that I found a discount coupon the night before checking out, so I couldn't make a reservation.)
area: District 1,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: Bay Hotel Ho Chi Minh
detail: Above all, I really liked the location. As a traveler, everything worth visiting was accessible by foot, and the cleanliness of the accommodation was well maintained. Especially, the breakfast was excellent compared to the hotels I had stayed at before. All the staff were friendly, and their attention to detail, even in small matters, stood out.
area: District 1,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: Grandma Lu's Saigon Signature
detail: They will inform you of the page to upload your passport image in advance. On the day, they will guide you via chat on how to receive your room key card. The room was small but very clean. There were toilets on each floor, and there were showers (although not warm) on two floors. I would like to repeat my stay.
area: District 1,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: Alagon Saigon Hotel & Spa
detail: The location, breakfast, and staff were all excellent! I stayed in a room without windows, but it was so dark that I upgraded to a larger room! The room after the change was fantastic. However, in both rooms, the drainage in the bathroom was poor, and water kept accumulating. Other than that, everything was really wonderful, and I would love to stay again!
area: District 1,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: Pullman Saigon Centre Hotel
detail: I stayed in the Executive Room at Pullman Saigon Center this time, and my satisfaction was very high. There was no need to crowd in the lobby on the first floor; I could conveniently and quickly go through a private check-in on the 30th floor lounge, making for a very comfortable first impression. In particular, the benefits of the 30th-floor Executive Lounge are truly excellent. I could enjoy a semi-buffet for free during lunch and dinner hours. While the variety isn't huge, the food composition is substantial, and I was satisfied to enjoy my meal with a view of Ho Chi Minh City from the 30th floor. A major advantage is that I could comfortably take care of both meals and relaxation in the lounge without needing to go outside. I highly recommend that anyone visiting Pullman Saigon Center books an Executive Room or higher to enjoy the benefits of the 30th-floor lounge.
area: District 1,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: The Solith Hotel Managed by Nicecy
detail: First of all, the hotel has a 24-hour front desk, which is very friendly for flights arriving in the early morning from Shanghai. The staff is very friendly and service-oriented. The hotel is located near Japan Street, with a 7-11 and FamilyMart downstairs, and there are countless delicious food options. Despite this, the rooms are quiet and comfortable. The breakfast is abundant and reasonably priced. It is within walking distance to Vincom and Saigon Centre in the city center, making shopping very convenient. A taxi from the airport takes about 20 minutes. This hotel is my top choice every time I come to Ho Chi Minh City.
area: District 1,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: Express by M Village Võ Thị Sáu, a brand of Modern Village Lifestyle
detail: Ho Chi Minh City is a bustling place with many cars and motorcycles, but this is a hidden, quiet hotel tucked away in a back alley. The café on the first floor, which opens early in the morning, is incredibly cozy, and I thought to myself, I want to live here! There is a free washing machine and a water dispenser. It also has a kitchen and a large refrigerator, so there's no worry if you can't finish your takeout! When I expressed my preference for a room with a window, they kindly agreed. Guests staying at this hotel can receive a 10% discount on drinks at the first-floor café, anytime! I definitely want to stay here again next time! Thank you very much.
